sideToMove.rule: A square whose border-ring median colour differs by more than 40 (sum of RGB differences) from the normal colour of its square colour is marked; red (R-G more than 35 above normal and G more than 25 below) is check and does not count. 1 to 4 marked squares whose occupied squares all hold the same colour mean that colour moved last.

themes.stage1: Look for a fork: a move that attacks two pieces at once.
A pawn move fits well here.
